alex_chang: Heads-up: launching joint marketplace listing with CloudAxis next week. We need to lock partner support escalation paths — SEV mapping, shared Slack channels, and war-room playbook. Who owns coordinating?
maria_lopez: I'll take point on partner comms. Need alignment on SEV definitions and phone escalation. Do we have existing doc?
kevin_ong: We do a basic mapping in ops handbook but it's not partner-friendly. Suggest: create partner-runbook + shared channel + partner ops contact list.
sara_ptak: Agree. For Dedicated partners we require a dedicated shared channel with restricted access. Naming convention: #partner-<vendor>-support. Add a war-room template: ```/warroom create <partner> <sev-level>```
jordan_partner_success: From CloudAxis side: they want an on-call rotation during launch window and a single dial-in. We'll give them a dedicated support engineer and SRE contact.
alex_chang: Good. Can someone draft the SEV mapping table? e.g., Redwood SEV1 = partner P1 (production down), SEV2 = major degradation, SEV3 = partial impact
kevin_ong: I'll draft. Also propose an escalation matrix (1st-line partner SE, 2nd-line Redwood SRE, 3rd-line Eng oncall). Phone/pager steps + 15min SLA for SEV1.
maria_lopez: Need to add PR/comms step for joint announcements — who signs off on public status pages? CloudAxis requires approval before posting.
jordan_partner_success: They need 2-hour Q&A SLA for any joint status page copy during launch. OK for Redwood?
sara_ptak: We can commit to 2 hrs during launch window, with legal and comms on standby. Add fallback: if no approval, we post neutral 'investigating' blurb.
ops_bot: War room created: #warroom-cloudaxis-launch by alex_chang. Link: https://warrooms.redwood.internal/abc123
alex_chang: Perfect. Kevin — share the draft mapping + runbook link in #partner-cloudaxis-support by EOD. Also schedule a 30-min tabletop tomorrow 10:30 PT.
kevin_ong: Will do. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/partner-sev-mapping (WIP). Planning tabletop invite in calendar.
maria_lopez: :thumbsup: I'll loop legal and comms. Jordan — can CloudAxis provide their on-call list and escalation phone numbers?
jordan_partner_success: Yes — sending in DM and will add to shared channel once it's created. Also we can join the tabletop.
alex_chang: :calendar: great. Call out action items: KEVIN (draft mapping + post), MARIA (legal/comms), SARA (create shared channel with access policy), JORDAN (partner on-call).
